svg.title: K10: the PVC asks for a StorageClass that does not exist
svg.desc: The Pod board mounts the claim board-data. The claim asks for StorageClass fast-ssd, which this cluster does not have, so no volume is ever created, the claim stays Pending and the Pod waits. The fix is to omit storageClassName so the default StorageClass is used.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
